description: Đường thực tế vẽ trước, sau mốc hôm nay một đường dự báo nét đứt kéo dài kèm dải mờ loe rộng dần về tương lai.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-data-story-confidence-fog, written here): Observed line (5 points) draws 300-1300 ms easeInOut, end dot. 'Today' divider + labels fade 1200-1500. Forecast: dashed (5/4) curve from the last point draws 1500-2800 ms easeOutCubic; behind it a band whose half-width grows linearly from 0 at today to +-34 px at the end, as 4 nested bands (100 / 72 / 46 / 22 % width) at 11 % opacity each, revealed in step with the forecast. Width bracket fades 2600-2900. Params: spread (±34 px) · bands (4) · forecast: thời gian dự báo (1.3 s).
